job.question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting services published in 2017?
job.acceptance: November27,2017 at 4:30pm HST; equivalent date/time format accepted.

reviews.reason: This is a Delaware Office of the State Treasurer RFP for deferred compensation plan recordkeeping, published in 2021—not the 2017 Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting services. Its proposal deadline does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: ISSUED BY THE OFFICE OF THE STATE TREASURER
DEFERRED COMPENSATION PLAN RECORDKEEPING AND ADMINISTRATION SERVICES
All proposals must be received no later than 4:00 p.m., prevailing Eastern time, on August 20, 2021
